{{Quote|Cyclone increases a user's speed and focus, transforming an average human into a natural assassin. It's also lethal&mdash;a minor defect.|[[Watcher X]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Cyclone''' was a stimulant produced by [[VerveGen Corporation]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It provided the recipient with increased strength and stamina, but was lethal in all cases with no exceptions. This design flaw was never fixed.
